Mobile app development for iOS, Android and the web

Custom apps that feel native on every screen, are designed around the people using them and are built to protect their data.

Start a projectCall +91-97470 90058

What is mobile app development?

Pixelbrahma develops cross-platform apps that run on iOS, Android and the web from a shared product design, so you reach more users without paying for three separate builds.

What we build

These are the kinds of apps we are commonly asked to create.

  1. 01

    Customer apps for ordering, booking and loyalty

  2. 02

    Internal tools that replace spreadsheets and chat threads

  3. 03

    Marketplace and storefront apps for small sellers

  4. 04

    Companion apps for an existing website or service

  5. 05

    Prototypes that test an idea before full investment

Platforms we ship to

  • iOS

    Apps prepared for the Apple App Store, following Apple's interface and review guidelines.

  • Android

    Apps prepared for Google Play across a wide range of screen sizes and devices.

  • Web

    Browser-based versions so users can reach the same product without an install.

Design and security

01

Custom UI/UX

We design interfaces from user journeys, not from templates. Every screen is tested against a simple question: can a first-time user finish the task without help?

  • User-flow maps and clickable prototypes
  • A reusable component library
  • Accessible colour, type and touch targets
02

Enhanced data security

Security is part of the architecture, not a final checklist. We plan how data is stored, transmitted and accessed before development begins.

  • Encrypted connections and careful handling of credentials
  • Role-based access where users have different permissions
  • Dependency updates and a review before release

From idea to the App Store

Whether it is a retail connect app, a field tool or a customer club, we start from the screens people touch every day.

Apps we have designed

Login and onboarding screens from real projects.

Our app development process

  1. 01

    Discovery workshop

    We map users, goals and constraints, then agree a first release that is small enough to ship.

  2. 02

    Prototype

    A clickable prototype lets you and real users try the core journey before code is written.

  3. 03

    Sprints

    Short build cycles end with a working build on your device and a review call.

  4. 04

    Store release

    We prepare listings, assets and submissions, and support you through review.

  5. 05

    Improve

    Analytics and feedback feed a prioritised list for the next release.

Mistakes to avoid when planning a mobile app

Short, practical lessons from projects like yours.

  1. Mistake 1

    Building every feature in version one

    Do this instead

    Launch a small first release around one core journey, then add features once real users show what they need.

  2. Mistake 2

    Skipping the prototype

    Do this instead

    Test a clickable prototype with real users before writing code, so expensive changes happen on paper.

  3. Mistake 3

    Treating security as a final checklist

    Do this instead

    Plan sign-in, data storage and permissions in the first sprint and review dependencies before every release.

What to prepare before we start on a mobile app

Having these ready lets us give you a sharper estimate and a faster first draft.

Send us your brief
  • A one-page description of the problem the app solves
  • Examples of apps you like and apps you want to avoid
  • Your brand colours, logo and any existing content
  • Who will approve designs and builds on your side

What decides the cost of mobile app development

We never quote blindly. After a short discovery call we send a written estimate that lists exactly what is included, so you can compare it with confidence.

Get a written estimate
  • +The number of screens, features and user roles in the app
  • +Design depth: from template-based layouts to fully custom work
  • +Content: whether you supply copy and images or we create them
  • +Timeline: urgent launches need more people working in parallel
  • +Support: a one-off delivery or an ongoing monthly retainer

Mobile app development FAQs

Costs, timelines, technology and store release, answered.

Ask us directly
Do I need separate apps for iPhone and Android?

Not necessarily. A cross-platform approach lets one shared codebase and design system serve both, which usually reduces cost and keeps the experience consistent.

Can you design the app and build it?

Yes. Our UI/UX designers and engineers work together, so what is designed is what gets built.

How do you protect user data?

We plan encryption, access control and safe storage during architecture, and review dependencies and permissions before every release.

Will you help publish to the App Store and Google Play?

Yes. We prepare store listings and assets, handle submissions and guide you through any review feedback.

What happens after launch?

You can continue with a monthly team or a maintenance plan covering updates, fixes and improvements.

How much does mobile app development cost in India?

The cost depends on the number of screens, the features, the integrations and whether you need an admin panel. We scope every app after a short discovery call and send a written estimate, so you know the range before any design work starts.

How long does it take to build a mobile app?

A focused first version usually takes a few months from wireframes to store release, and larger products take longer. We agree a milestone plan up front so you can see progress at every stage.

Which technologies do you use for cross-platform app development?

We choose the stack that fits your product, using cross-platform frameworks where they give you one codebase for iOS and Android and native code where performance demands it.

Do you build apps for startups in Bengaluru, Kochi and Canada?

Yes. Our teams in Bengaluru, Kochi and Brampton work with startups and established brands, and most projects run through video calls with regular demos.

Tell us about your app idea

Tell us what you are working on. We will reply with questions and a suggested next step.
